basic_profile.bio: I'm a 33-year-old librarian from Vancouver, Canada with a passion for storytelling, whether through books, anime, or music. Married to my college sweetheart, I've been a dedicated Redditor for over seven years, usually logging in during evenings and weekends. My work keeps me surrounded by literature, so I unwind by exploring new anime series, enjoying the beats of Anderson .Paak, and helping fellow Nintendo enthusiasts troubleshoot their Switch issues.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Master's degree in Library Science, I have a strong foundation in information curation and literary analysis. My love for anime and manga has led me to self-teach Japanese, enhancing my cultural understanding. Regularly engaging with online communities has further honed my skills in digital literacy and community moderation.
